pages.contents: One landscape CARE Checklist of information to include when writing a case report. The red-headed table lists reporting topics/items 1–13: title, keywords, abstract, introduction, patient information, clinical findings, timeline, diagnostic assessment, therapeutic intervention, follow-up/outcomes, discussion, patient perspective and informed consent. Selected Reported on Line entries read 1–2, 34–35, 14–33, 36–43, 44–95, 97–140 and 141–143. Other checklist line-reference cells are blank. The informed-consent Yes box contains X and the No box is blank. The top of the page bears the CARE logo and a BY-NC-ND license badge.
pages.clinical_relevance_notes: Administrative reporting checklist with manuscript line references and a consent checkbox. It contains no new individual history, test results, measurements, doses, treatment course or outcomes. Blank checklist reference cells are not patient clinical negatives or proof that tests were omitted. No clinical-schema facts are generated from this document.
